name: Weathering Feelings
source:
This is a demo VN that was made for people in need of support and comfort with someone who wants to listen. Sit back and take our quiz to see which of our two therapists will be perfect for you!

Please, come into their office and get ready to weather through your feelings!

[From [url=https://undeadbeesgames.itch.io/weathering-feelings]Itch.io[/url]]

Warning: This game is not meant to be a replacement for actual therapy. If you need help, please reach out to a real life professional. This game is 18+ and will contain gaslighting, psychological horror, and descriptions of gore when complete.
translation:
这是一个演示VN，专为需要支持和安慰的人而制作，希望有人愿意倾听。请坐下来参加我们的测验，看看我们的两位治疗师中哪一位最适合你！

请来到他们的办公室，准备好承受你的感受！

[来自[url=https://undeadbeesgames.itch.io/weathering-feelings]Itch.io[/url]]

警告：本游戏并不意味着可以替代实际治疗。如果你需要帮助，请联系现实生活中的专业人士。该游戏年龄在18岁以上，完成后将包含煤气灯、心理恐怖和血腥描述。
